newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa says D&P rating a vote of confidence.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa says D&P rating a vote of confidence.

text.p: South Africa's Finance Ministry said on Wednesday that Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co's award of an investment grade rating was a positive signal to U.S. and other potential investors.

The U.S. rating agency announced earlier it had accorded South Africa a BBB minus investment grade rating -- the second U.S. agency to do so following Moody's Investors Services investment grade Baa3 rating last year.

"The investment rating is especially significant in that, in terms of securities regulations in the U.S., certain investors, such as insurance funds, are restricted in terms of their investments when a country does not have two investment grade ratings from U.S. accredited agencies," the Ministry said in a statement.
It added that in view of the pending Yankee bond issue, expected to be launched in July, it was very pleased with the vote of confidence the rating represented.
